name: d1_dance_ref
prompt: The woman from <Picture 1>, same face, same jaw-length black bob with blunt bangs, same silver hoop earrings, same glossy cobalt-blue bomber jacket over a white t-shirt and black trousers. Cinematic music video, locked-off static camera, wide full-body shot. She dances alone in a huge empty bare concrete studio at night: big sharp arm swings, turns, a jump, hair flying, then a sudden freeze facing the camera. Behind her a tall flat smooth grey concrete wall fills the whole background with lots of empty space above and around her. One hard white light from the side, deep teal shadows, wet reflective concrete floor. No text, no logos, no mirrors, no other people. High contrast, film grain.
